steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing bootcamp instruction, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including proof of your contact hours and work experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at application. Plan your renewal activities early to sustain your credential and stay competitive in Billings's project-driven sectors.
